mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_device (tenant_id, product_id, device_code, device_name, status, online_status, last_online_time, last_offline_time, metadata, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productId}, #{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{status}, #{onlineStatus}, #{lastOnlineTime}, #{lastOfflineTime}, #{metadata}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, product_id, device_code, device_name, status, online_status, last_online_time, last_offline_time, metadata, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_device WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC
